EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Hey, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Did you forget

supposed to come over.
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}I waited and waited because I really
wanted to see you.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Please try to
make it next time.

{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡No te enfades conmigo, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}por favor!

{{TAG:0005:0008:}}...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Tu sais, je t'avais

{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0027:}}Ich hab dich extra zu

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Let me just say{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}I'm so sorry!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
I know we had plans to hang out at
my house,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but I completely forgot.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}It wasn't intentional.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Something
really important came up, and my
mind pushed everything else aside.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I promise to be more careful next
time.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Please don't hold this
against me.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Mmm{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Lo siento muchísimo!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Sé que habíamos quedado, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}pero se

{{TAG:0003:0024:}}No sé, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}me he puesto a hacer otras

Por favor, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}no me guardes rencor

{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Oh, je suis vraiment navrée !{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} J'ai

{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Mmmmmh{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Mi dispiace tanto!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Lo so{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} che avevamo in programma di

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}What happened to you, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}You disappeared so suddenly on the
way to my house!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} I was really
worried about you.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}But I'm glad to see that you're all

{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡¿Qué te ha pasado,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Íbamos de camino a mi casita
